mapper.select: SELECT * FROM proj_delivery_definition_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND id=#{query.revisionId} AND deleted=0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE proj_delivery_definition_revision SET payload=#{row.payload}, schema_version=#{row.schemaVersion}, version=version+1, updater=#{row.updater}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{row.id} AND tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND version=#{row.version} AND revision_state='DRAFT' AND deleted=0

UPDATE proj_delivery_definition_revision SET revision_state='PUBLISHED', published_at=#{row.publishedAt}, version=version+1, updater=#{row.updater}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{row.id} AND tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND version=#{row.version} AND revision_state='DRAFT' AND deleted=0

UPDATE proj_delivery_definition_revision SET disabled_at=#{row.disabledAt}, version=version+1, updater=#{row.updater}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{row.id} AND tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND version=#{row.version} AND revision_state='PUBLISHED' AND disabled_at IS NULL AND deleted=0
